# origincloud_network_floating_ip_associations (Data Source)

Lists a floating IP's associations: none or one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `floating_ip` (String) The floating ip whose floating ip associations to list. Its `id`, the full resource name `//network.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/floatingIps/{floating_ip}`. `project` and `zone` must be the ones it is in.
- `project` (String) The project whose floating ip associations to list.
- `zone` (String) The zone whose floating ip associations to list.

### Read-Only

- `floating_ip_associations` (Attributes List) The floating ip associations listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--floating_ip_associations))

<a id="nestedatt--floating_ip_associations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `floating_ip_associations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The floating ip association's full resource name, `//network.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/floatingIps/{floating_ip}/associations/{association}`: what an argument that refers to the floating ip association takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `name` (String) The association's resource name. Its last segment is the network interface's id.
- `network_interface` (String) The full name of the network interface the address reaches, in the floating IP's project and zone.
- `private_address` (String) The interface's private IPv4 address the public one translates to.
